description: A UC Berkeley dataset of over 11 million timestamped student course-enrollment transactions from Fall 2016 through Spring 2022, released with public analysis code by Borchers et al.

description: Uceph is a digital orthodontic-training platform from Chengdu, China that provides scored landmarking practice and visual correction feedback on lateral radiographs for preclinical students.

title: UChicago Consortium's research-practice partnership model

description: A UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset of demographic, social, family, and school-related attributes from students at two Portuguese secondary schools, with Mathematics and Portuguese subject records used for student-performance prediction.
title: UCI Student Performance dataset (two Portuguese secondary schools)

description: An interactive, hierarchically organized online competency framework published by University College London that links broad areas of knowledge, skills, and attitudes to more detailed competence items for acute mental health care.
title: UCL competency framework

description: A UCLA Center X and Los Angeles Unified School District teacher-residency programme that prepared early-childhood and multiple-subject teachers through integrated graduate coursework, certification pathways, intensive clinical placements, and mentored practice.
title: UCLA IMPACT ECE/Multiple Subject Program

description: The UCSF Mathematical Cognition Battery is an experimental battery developed by the UCSF Dyslexia Center to assess mathematical strengths and difficulties in children in grades 2–8, including those referred for dyslexia evaluation.
title: UCSF Mathematical Cognition Battery (MCB)

description: A University of Chicago School Mathematics Project curriculum package for secondary mathematics courses, including student textbooks, teacher editions and resources, assessment materials, and technology resources.
title: UCSMP secondary mathematics curriculum
